title: Easy Roasted Croatian Pork Roast
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring a juicy pork roast with a crispy crust, perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner. The addition of mustard seeds gives it a unique flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard seeds, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Rub the mixture all over the pork roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork roast in a large roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the pork for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the pork into thin slices and serve with your choice of sides.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
